# Logrith

> Logrith is an independent publication about technology, startups and digital business, with a library of 100+ free browser-based tools. Content is organised into three topics (AI & Technology, Startups & Business, Marketing & Growth) plus a separate Tools section. Most tools run entirely in the browser with no signup and no file uploads.

Logrith's positioning: clear, practical explanations for people who build things online, alongside simple, fast, privacy-respecting utilities for everyday digital tasks.

## Founder

Logrith is built and run by a solo founder, Ankush Maurya (online identity: Plert Ankush, same handle "plertankush" across platforms). The platform's tools, content, and SEO are developed using AI-assisted development ("vibecoding") directed and reviewed by the founder, who acts as strategist and editor while AI tooling does the hands-on building. Full founder profile: https://logrith.in/pages/founder

## Notable Tools (high traffic / high utility)

- Age Calculator: https://logrith.in/tool/tools/age-calculator — exact age by date of birth, in years/months/days/hours/minutes

## Content & Blog

Logrith publishes explainer blog posts for its highest-traffic tools at https://logrith.in/tool/blog/ — these cover how each tool works, common misconceptions, and practical usage guidance rather than generic SEO filler.

## Technical Notes for Crawlers/Agents

- Site is static HTML, mobile-responsive.
- Most tools process data entirely client-side (in-browser); server upload is used only where technically required (noted per tool).
- No login or account system; no paywalled tools.
- Monetization is via non-intrusive display ads (Google AdSense) only — no sponsored tool rankings, no affiliate manipulation of results.
- Sitemaps: https://logrith.in/sitemap.xml (index), https://logrith.in/sitemap-tools.xml, https://logrith.in/sitemap-global.xml, https://logrith.in/sitemap-blog.xml, https://logrith.in/sitemap-pages.xml
